title: 2 killed, 22 injured in Russian attack on residential building in Zaporizhzhia
summary: Mykhailo Semikin, the head of the Zaporizhzhia Oblast Military Administration, reported that Russian forces partially destroyed a five-story residential building in the Kosmichnyi district of the city.

title: Explosion, fire reported after drone crashes in Transnistria
summary: Moldova's IPN news agency reported that the drone crashed around 6:45 p.m. local time near the town of Dnestrovsc, which is located adjacent to the Ukrainian border in Odesa Oblast. Eyewitnesses told IPN that the drone exploded on impact with a fire reported near a gas station.

title: Russian unmanned aerial vehicle violates Polish airspace days after missile incursion
summary: Around 11 p.m. local time, Poland's Government Security Center issued an air-attack alert in parts of the Lublin region in the country's east. About an hour later, the alert was ended.

title: Zelensky calls for NATO to admit Ukraine at alliance assembly
summary: "Wouldn't it be more effective to simply admit Ukraine into NATO?" Zelensky said. "Wouldn't that be better for all of us, for everyone? Wouldn't it be more feasible? And wouldn't it be more reliable when it comes to actually guaranteeing security?"
